병원 진료후 급 검색후 방문. 오픈 시간이 12시라 좀 기다리다 입장. 생각보다 매장이 넓지는 않았다. 생갈비 2인분과 토마호크 주문. 토마호크를 넘 맛나게 먹어 그 후에 먹은 갈비의 맛은 제대로 모르겠다. 직원들 모두 친절하고 고기도 구워주고..고기 먹는 법도 알려주고..밑반찬 리필도 바로바로 해주셔서 정말 잘 먹었다. 방울토마토와 꽈리고추를 같이 구워주어서 맛있게 먹었다. 주차도 편리하고.. 삼겹살을 맛보지 못하여 아쉬움이.. 육회 초밥은 신선하여 괜찮았다. 가격대비 맛대비 두루두루 괜찮았음을..
갈비살 진짜 고소하고 맛있어요. 돈마호크도 부드럽고 맛있음. 절임갓이 맛있고 고기를 맛있게 다 구워줌..강추

This quaint, Hanok style cafe is definitely a must-visit in Jeonju! They serve great coffee and tea, and also Korean sweet jelly desserts. Highly recommend the Chagyeong coffee, which (I think) is cafe latte topped with sweet tiramisu/irish cream foam!
We had the Chagyeong latte and green tea latte! So good! I think we’re not use the the texture of the jelly, it’s kinda denser than jelly.

rv.t: My kids enjoyed coming here. I truly never want to affect a local business which is why I went with 4 stars. But if you are the business owner and don’t mind some constructive criticism - you desperately need to do a better job cleaning up. The counters, floors, and windows are filthy. Use ammonia and a squeegee to clean your storefront windows. Use a steam cleaner to get the gunk off the surfaces. Properly scrub…

Ice cream and more. I actually couldn't count how many other deserts available besides ice cream. We had good service and the shop was clean. For ice cream they had dairy and non-dairy options and tons of flavors I have never seen before like cookie monster, Mike and Ike, etc. I would rate the ice cream flavor as okay for the price. It's a good place to take kids for a fun experience.

I went in to snow monster for the first time ever! I went with my friend and she said the coffee here was good so I got the MEDIUM iced coffee and this is what I got. I re-confirmed with the person who made it for me, and she said that yes, this is the medium size cup. I paid $4 for the medium size coffee, and the coffee was really good. The price however was questionable for the size of the cup.

The mall has a great mix of local and international stores, plenty of food options, and a welcoming atmosphere that's perfect for spending the day. Whether you're looking for souvenirs, enjoying a meal, or simply exploring, Micronesia Mall offers something for…
The most mallsoft vaporwave mall I’ve ever been! Love its aesthetics!!
American style mall with huge assortment of stores. You can find Ross and Macy's store here.

1764.aj: チャモロ ナイト マーケット West Marine Drive #153 Hagåtña, 96913 グアム

rv.t: Yummy 😋 cool stuff to buy too, if my kids were younger I’d take them for sure. I need to go again before I go home. The corn is serious off the hook out of control, in a good way.

I believe most hotels, including PIC, have scaled back their BBQ programs to encourage growth in the local market. There’s nothing particularly special about the BBQ itself—its main draw is simply the lively atmosphere. If you’re not someone who enjoys waiting in line, I wouldn’t recommend it. For me, it was worth experiencing once, as long as you don’t mind waiting about 40 minutes. If you don’t have a car or hotel…

This night market was a highlight of the trip, part food festival, part cultural celebration. Picture an outdoor farmers market with rows of vendors, but the real star is the food. We had fried pork belly and crispy pork chop strips that hit the spot! There were tons of options: seafood stir fry, grilled chicken skewers, red rice, smoothies, and fresh fruit juices. Live music was playing the Electric Slide as we…

rv.t: Visited the last remaining Kmart and had a great experience. The store is incredibly clean, organized, and the prices are still very decent. The staff here are also super friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend stopping by to check it out!
Lots of stuff to buy in KMart from house needs, food, clothing, sports, school stuff and toiletrie and meds. I found some filipino brands of sauces, snacks and condiments. Everything under one roof.

It is much cheaper than ABC Mart and has a lot of industrial products. If you want to buy a gift set, I recommend you to stop by this side and buy them all at once. The types of snacks are very cheap. Character shampoo is popular with children. I think it would be better to induce gifts there than toys. There is a pizza shop in the mart, and you can get a nice pizza at about $11. I recommend you to try it.

1766.a: Lone Star Steakhouse, 615 S Marine Corps Dr, Apotgan, 96913, Guam
1766.aj: ローンスターステーキハウス 615 S Marine Corps Dr, Apotgan, 96913 グアム
catj: 仕出し・ケータリング

rv.t: The food was delicious but took a long time due to how full the place was. Asked for medium rare and that's what I got. Great grill marks and flavor, but I wish it was pre-seasoned prior. Still, with some salt and pepper it was fantastic. The sweet potato fries were on point. My friend had the chicken pasta and they said it was pretty good. The Texan decor was cool, I liked the murals on the back walls. The server…

Good steakhouse. The new York steak and the brussel sprouts was very good. The broccoli is to be avoided because it is not the normal US broccoli. The bread is excellent. On the day we were there they ran out of lots of things, such as ahi, prime rib and some steaks cuts with bones.

This is the worst Lonestar I have ever been to. How do you make a chewy medium steak and you’re literally a steakhouse? My husband got a baked sweet potato that was cold on the inside and the “sweet” butter was just regular butter with brown sugar sprinkled on top. I got the loaded baked potato (wasn’t cooked all the way) that tasted like absolutely nothing and there was no salt and pepper on the table. Will never…

1767.ed: Coastal area offering snorkeling, fishing & sunbathing, plus lodging, dining & entertainment.
1767.edj: シュノーケリング、釣り、日光浴を楽しめるビーチ。宿泊施設とレストランがあり、エンターテイメントも用意されている。

rv.t: ☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆ If there is one place that perfectly represents the beauty of Guam, it is Tumon Bay. From the moment you arrive, you're greeted by crystal-clear turquoise waters, powdery white sand, and a breathtaking coastline that rivals some of the best beaches in the Pacific. The water is remarkably calm thanks to the protective reef surrounding much of the bay. This makes it ideal for swimming, paddleboarding…

It is stunningly beautiful at any time of the day. Due to its excellent location, this beach is almost sunlit from sunrise to sunset. It is worth visiting at different times of the day, because the sky and water are always a little different in color. There are several access points to the beach: for example, at the large intersection, behind the Dusit Beach Resort, on the north side of Sails BBQ; or on the south…
The water is crystal clear and the depth is perfect for the whole family to play together. It is a recommended water play destination.

1768.a: The Tsubaki Tower, 241 Gun Beach Road 27 th floor, Tumon, 96913, Guam
1768.aj: ザ ツバキ タワー 241 Gun Beach Road 27 th floor, Tumon, 96913 グアム
1768.ed: Luxe hotel offering ocean views, outdoor pools & a spa, plus restaurants, bars & an open-air cinema.
1768.edj: 海を望む豪華なホテル。屋外プール、スパ、レストラン、バー、屋外映画館を併設。

rv.t: I had a wonderful stay at The Tsubaki Tower. The hotel offers a truly luxurious experience with stunning ocean views that make every moment feel relaxing and special. The rooms are modern, spacious, and exceptionally clean, with thoughtful details that make the stay very comfortable. The atmosphere throughout the hotel feels peaceful and elegant, perfect for both vacation and relaxation. The service was outstanding…

We stayed at The Tsubaki Tower with our 11-month-old son and had an amazing experience. We’re a couple in our mid-30s and stayed in a Junior Suite on the 20th floor. Everything was perfect—the lobby, room condition, facilities, food, pool, view, and service. Nothing disappointed us. Since we were traveling with a baby, we spent a lot of time at the club lounge, and the lounge staff were incredibly warm and welcoming…

For the price, I was very Disappointed! I couldn't see the sunset from the infinity pool, nor could I see it from my room! There were stains everywhere in my room. I was on the 17th floor with my balcony door shut and yet the piano music playing at the pool side drove me mad! When I went to relax by the pool, there was a loud Zumba class going on. Not relaxing. The pool towels were of poor quality too. Difficult…

1769.a: 3/F, Panda Hotel, Panda Place, 3號 Tsuen Wah St, Tsuen Wan, New Territories, Hong Kong
1769.aj: 3/F パンダホテル Panda Place, 3號 Tsuen Wah St, Tsuen Wan, New Territories, 香港
1769.ed: Vibrant lodging offering warm rooms & suites, plus 3 restaurants & an outdoor pool.
1769.edj: 華やかな雰囲気のホテル。温かみのある客室とスイートを備えている。3 軒のレストランと屋外プールを併設。

rv.t: We stayed at Panda Hotel Hong Kong with my family and overall had a very pleasant experience. Our room was spacious compared to many other hotels in Hong Kong, which made our stay more enjoyable, especially while traveling with family. The hotel offers great value for money, with comfortable rooms, a convenient location, and easy access to public transportation, shopping, and dining options. The staff were friendly…

Highly appreciated the efficient customer service at Panda Hotel. The WIFI in the room keeps dropping. Contacted the reception, Alison, and she immediately arranged someone to set up something like an internet support box. The wifi service resumed well. Thehotel is a bit old but clean and tidy. However, the location is good. The room rate is reasonable. The best is the overall hotel customer service is good.

This review is for the staff and management. Richard, the front desk was professional, detail, organized, and kind. Check-in was smooth. When there was a room issue, Richard connected me with Sheila, the hotel manager. She is super sweet, professional, and took care of the problem in no time. She helped me haul my luggages from room to room. I will stay here again just for them.

1770.a: Lartecono Davinci Gelato (Plaka), Sellei 4, Athina 105 58, Greece
1770.aj: Lartecono Davinci Gelato (Plaka), Sellei 4, Athina 105 58 ギリシャ

rv.t: The cheesecake flavor was rich and creamy, it tasted just like a fresh-baked dessert. The Greek yogurt flavor was great as well. The staff members were so funny and welcoming. They recommended several different flavors and even let me try a few samples before I made my final decision.

It offers a very wide selection with many different varieties, giving plenty of choice. The texture is exactly like authentic gelato. However, for my taste, the sugar level was a bit high. Most of the flavors we tried were consistent with their names in terms of taste.

A great place to pick up a gelato, with a broad selection of flavours to choose from. We visited twice during a trip to Athens. I first chose dulce de leche (which was deliciously creamy and I would highly recommend) and second Nutella. My companion had tiramisu first and the Greek yoghurt second. Both cone and cup options for their regular size were €5.50.

1771.ed: Classic Greek fare in a simple, airy space with a roof terrace for amazing Acropolis views.

rv.t: The only star is given for the view and because it’s the least anyone can give. The appetizers were ok, but the main entrees were not good. Protein was very underwhelming (no taste, rubbery, and cold), my potatoes with shrimp (some vein was still there) were cold and not tasty at all. Not even salt was used for seasoning. The lamb was chewy and tough. The fish was not seasoned. We had to pay 40 Euros per person to…

Dining at this rooftop restaurant in Athens was a truly memorable experience. The view of the Acropolis lit up at night is absolutely stunning and creates a magical atmosphere that’s hard to beat. The food was delicious and well-prepared, and the ambiance of the space made it perfect for a relaxed evening. What really made our night stand out, though, was the service. Our waiter was exceptionally polite, attentive…

The restaurant is nice, but the main reason to come is for the amazing view of the acropolis. The food is fair enough - nothing fancy or unique. Staff was having a bit of trouble getting around but they were so friendly that you just can’t get mad. I recommend it.

rv.t: The banana date smoothie with milk was delicious, although the (bamboo?) straw was a bit hard to drink through. That‘s why they hand out spoons for the chunks of date at the bottom as well. The avocado toast was simple yet really delicious. Seats are limited and you have an hour to finish up. Service was friendly and quick, although I did have the impression that they got way nicer after my Japanese friend arrived…

Adding to my favorite places in Ebisu. Sitting is limited and customers are given an hour to finish their meals. I need to go back for the smoothie bowls with hempseeds. I love. It's a place for those of us will food allergies and intolerance to eat comfortable.
Love this place! Cute vibe, nice sitting area, friendly service. Was happy they have many vegan options for myself, and some non veg options for my partner. The Açai bowl was really good!

1773.edj: 遺跡群にある修復された歴史的な神殿跡。紀元前 447 年に建てられたドリス式円柱で有名。

rv.t: Beautiful historical site. I recommend booking a time slot at least 1-2 days before, otherwise you might spend about an hour or so waiting in various queues (summer time). Once in the acropolis and around the parthenon, there is limited shade and the walking track is slippery. Wear clothes suitable for the sun and shoes with grip (and still walk carefully). Breathtaking sights of the city from various points within…

meraviglioso. Peccato per le transenne…. Un cantiere aperto da vent anni. Forse ancor più bello visto da Thissio al tramonto e alla notte. Athens completely stole my heart with its breathtaking mix of history and culture. Standing before the colossal Parthenon was an unforgettable, deeply humbling experience. Seeing that ancient temple silhouette against the brilliant Greek sky is pure magic. Just down the hill, the…

Absolutely staggering place. It's a bit of a trek up the hill, so wear stout shoes, bring water because it's usually hot weather and I would advise advance booking because the queues for tickets can be long. After that, be prepared to have your breath taken away...

1774.a: Moxy Athens City, Stadiou 65, Athina 105 51, Greece
1774.aj: Moxy Athens City, Stadiou 65, Athina 105 51 ギリシャ
1774.ed: Cozy, streamlined rooms in an eclectic hotel featuring a fitness center & a laid-back lobby bar.
1774.edj: フィットネスセンターと落ち着いた雰囲気のロビーバーを備えた、個性的なホテルの、居心地の良い洗練された客室。

rv.t: The hotel is located in a unique part of Athens. We loved it and we loved the hotel. The staff are young and cool. The breakfast was amazing and right across the street is this amazing bakery. Also it’s a 14 minute, interesting walk to Monastiraki and the 5 mire to Plaka. In that walk is true “local “ experience! The city offers great food. Great coffee and wonderful hospitality. I could go on forever with our love…

Staff was super friendly and service oriented. They surprised us with a gift for our birthday.During breakfast they served water and helped gettings things from the buffet for people who had difficulty walking Very warm service ike in the middle east and asia.Rooms are big, comfortable bed and a nice designAlso a cool area in the lobby to get work done.Perfect location next to the metro

This was a nice, clean hotel located very close to the main sites in Athens. Its not in the best neighborhood but I felt very safe while inside the hotel and in the immediate vicinity. The best thing about this hotel was the staff--they were extremely friendly and helpful. I also really enjoyed the buffet breakfast, it was awesome! The room service I ordered for dinner was also really good. The rooms are small but…

1775.a: Japan, 〒369-1305 Saitama, Chichibu District, Nagatoro, 453-2 長瀞秩父館 丹一
1775.aj: 〒369-1305 埼玉県秩父郡長瀞町長瀞４５３−２ 長瀞秩父館 丹一
1775.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious ayu meshi, a flavorful rice dish with tender ayu fish, and crispy grilled ayu. They also highlight the charming, traditional atmosphere and the convenient riverside location. Other reviews mention the service can be unhelpful.
1775.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、風味豊かな鮎めしや、香ばしく焼き上げられた鮎の塩焼きを高く評価しています。また、趣のある伝統的な雰囲気や、便利な川沿いの立地も好評のようです。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: the atmosphere was really great. But the fish had so many bones. It was hard to eat. Maybe next time, I should order the fried fish....

Ayu (river fish) is the main dish here, only serving it with rice, deep fried etc. Fish was fresh, well cooked! The whole place was nice with very friendly staff. Minus point for the price : 2200 yens for the ayu rice (1 person), which includes rice cooked into ayu broth with 2 fishes in it + 1 small side dish with eggplant. Not sure about the price of ayu itself, but it seemed to us on the pricey side.

Unbelievably overpriced, first we been leaded to a taatami table, and after we ordered, one waitress asked us to move to another table, that was incredibly rude and unexpected, the worse part is, she didn’t even asked the others sitting next to us cause THEY ARE JAPANESE. And also first I thought maybe cause groups of people are waiting or this is a reservation one, but turned out there’s not even lining up outside…

Every single corner has been thoughtfully designed. From the moment you walk in until you reach the back of the restaurant, there’s something new to admire. I honestly could have spent hours just exploring the space and taking photos. Even the bathrooms…

Came here for brunch and got the full breakfast with bacon, Mexicano schnitzel, beef burger, nasi goreng, mie goreng, fries, cookie monster shake, berry smoothie and iced coffees. Cafe was nice and beautifully decorated. Service was amazing like with pretty much everywhere in Bali. The food wasnt too bad, surprisingly the Western food tasted better than the Indonesian food. Like I really felt that the nasi and the…

Had breakfast here during my recent visit to Canggu, and it was a great experience. The atmosphere and vibes are fantastic—relaxed, stylish, and very much in line with Canggu’s laid-back charm. It’s the kind of place where you can easily spend a leisurely morning. The menu offers a good selection of breakfast and brunch options, making it difficult to choose. The food was delicious, well presented, and satisfying. I…

1777.a: Cafe Wayan, Jl. Monkey Forest, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia
1777.aj: カフェ・ワヤン Jl. Monkey Forest, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571 インドネシア

1777.edj: おしゃれなベーカリー＆カフェ。世界各国の料理やデザート、そして庭園の景色をお楽しみいただけます。

rv.t: We had a wonderful lunch here! The Indonesian food was absolutely excellent, and the entire setting is stunning. The restaurant is designed like a beautiful, garden complete with lovely fish ponds that make for an incredibly peaceful ambiance. Our son completely loved feeding the fish and roaming around the gorgeous garden paths, which kept him happily entertained. The staff were also very courteous and welcoming to…

We booked the cooking class on a whim after seeing the sign out the front and we were so glad that we did! The set up is fantastic in the garden at the back of the restaurant. The staff were all lovely and helpful and the food that we cooked was delicious. We got to eat at a beautiful table in the garden and it was so pretty. I can't wait to get home and cook the recipes we learnt for our family and friends.

Visited there in August 2025. 1778.aj: HAPPY SWING BALI, Tegallalang, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80561 インドネシア

rv.t: Purpose built location to get some nice pics. 6 spots around the property with scenic views with swings and seats where the staff will take a vid and pics with your own phone. You are strapped on the swing and its off a cliff so not for ones with phobias. Best to take full package for all spots than paying for separate ones. 350K for all spots with western dress for the lady and 450K with balinese costumes. Also has…

Had an unforgettable experience at Happy Swing Bali in Bali! If you’re looking for that iconic Bali swing photo with breathtaking views, this is the perfect place. There are multiple photo spots and beautifully designed nests, making it ideal for capturing amazing pictures. The team even helps with taking photos and guiding poses, which is a big plus! Also they provide beautiful, colorful flowing dresses on site…
Amazing experience! Stay was so helpful and got all the right shots! They have someone who will take photos and videos with your phone and mine can out great!!

1779.a: P8MR+48V Montana Del Cafe, Penelokan Main Rd No.889, South Batur, Kintamani, Bangli Regency, Bali 80652, Indonesia
1779.aj: P8MR+48V Montana Del Cafe, Jl. Raya Penelokan No.889, Batur Sel., Kec. Kintamani, Kabupaten Bangli, Bali 80652 インドネシア

Batur at sunrise while sipping amazing specialty coffee. The interior of the café is also top-notch, with comfortable seating spread across two levels. Very authentic and smooth. Would definitely be back. Good music and super chill with lots of shade. A hidden gem for sure!

I had a really nice experience at Koast Cafe. The place has a cozy, relaxed vibe perfect for a chill breakfast or brunch. I ordered the burger with fries and a coffee, and everything was solid. The burger was juicy, the fries crispy, and the coffee was well-made. Also tried the fried rice with egg simple but really flavorful and satisfying. The drinks were refreshing too, especially on a hot day in Canggu. Service…

I recommande to juste sit in one and enjoy the view maybe a little walk but no need to do the full trek circuit…

Amazing architecture and great service! Pillars, doors, windows, furniture, almost everything is made by bamboo in this villa. It’s very beautiful, luxury and comfortable. 初めて宿泊しましたが、お部屋、お食事、温泉、設備すべてが素晴らしく、大変満足な滞在となりました。お部屋は十分すぎるほど広く清潔感があり、地産地消にこだわったおもてなしディナーは最高に美味しかったです。真っ黒な温泉もヌルヌルとした泉質でとても心地よく、心身ともに癒やされました。1点だけ、お部屋にクッション（Yogibo）はあったのですが、少し立ち上がりにくさを感じたため、通常のソファーが1つでもあると、より快適にリラックスして過ごせるなと感じました。全体としては本当に申し分ない素晴らしいヴィラですので、ぜひまた利用させていただきたいです。ありがとうございました。
